hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; [ -d node_modules/playwright-core ] || PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1 npm install --no-audit --no-fund >/tmp/neuroster-npm-install.log 2>&1 || true; echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"Playwright (playwright-core) is installed; Chromium ships in PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH (/opt/pw-browsers). Verify UI changes in a real browser with: npm run verify:browser"}}'

{ echo '📋 PROJECT WALL — session-start sweep is a STANDING RULE: reconcile stale board items BEFORE feature work. Verify In-Progress items against open/merged PRs, drop fragments via tools/board_lifecycle.py, run python tools/compact_board_fragments.py, then commit. Current audit:'; python3 tools/board_lifecycle.py audit 2>/dev/null; } | jq -Rs '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:.}}'

sid=$(jq -r '.session_id // "x"'); f="/tmp/.wall-sweep-stop-$sid"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then exit 0; fi; touch "$f"; echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"END-OF-SESSION WALL SWEEP (standing rule): before ending, reconcile the project wall — run `python tools/board_lifecycle.py audit`, drop fragments for any status changes since session start (merged PRs -> Shipped, partial work -> In Progress, etc.), run `python tools/compact_board_fragments.py`, and commit the result. If the wall is already accurate and committed, you may stop."}'
